senses.gloss:
चञ्च् चञ्च्, cl. 1. P. चञ्चति, चचञ्च,
चञ्चितुम्, &c., to leap, jump; to go,
move; to dangle; [cf. Hib. ceangtha, ‘they go, travel;
ceangastair, ‘walking, pacing;’ Lat. cunctari ?].

चञ्च, अस्, m. a basket; (आ), f. anything made of
cane, a mat, a stool &c. made of reeds or basket-
work; a straw-man, a doll; a puppet of grass or
reeds; a contemptuous epithet of a man.

चञ्चत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, leaping, going, moving;
dangling; unsteady, shaking.

चञ्चत्क, अस्, आ, अम्, leaping, jumping, trembling,
moving.

चञ्चु, उस्, उस्, उ, renowned, celebrated, known;
clever [cf. चञ्चु-ता, चुञ्चु, चण, and अक्षर-
चञ्चु]; (उस्), m. a deer; N. of several plants, the
castor-oil plant, Ricinus Communis (एरण्ड); also
= रक्तैरण्ड and क्षुद्र-चञ्चु, = गोनाडीक;
N. of a son of Harita; (उस्), f. a beak, bill; a kind of
vegetable, = चञ्चू, चञ्चु-पत्त्र, &c.
—चञ्चु-ता,
f. celebrity, cleverness, activity; the state of a beak.
—चञ्चु-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable, =
चञ्चु, f.
—चञ्चु-पुट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bill of
a bird when shut.
—चञ्चु-प्रहार, अस्, m. a peck
with the beak.
—चञ्चु-भृत्, त्, m. ‘having a beak,’
a bird.
—चञ्चु-मत्, आन्, अती, m. f. ‘possessed of a
beak,’ a bird.
—चञ्चु-सूचि, इस्, m. the tailor-bird,
Sylvia Sutoria; also चञ्चुसूचिक, अस्, m.
चञ्चु चञ्चु. See under rt. चुञ्च्.

चञ्चू, ऊस्, f. a beak, the bill of a bird; a kind of
vegetable. See चञ्चु above.

चञ्चूक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people to the south-
west of Madhya-deśa.

1. चञ्चुर, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable, = चञ्चु,
f.; [cf. the following.]

2. चञ्चुर, अस्, आ, अम्, going repeatedly, expert
in, conversant with.
चञ्चुर चञ्चुर. See under चञ्च् and चञ्चरिन्.

चञ्चरिन् चञ्चरिन्, ई, m. or चञ्चरी, f. or
[]
चञ्चरीक, अस्, m. (fr. Intens. of rt. चर्), a bee.
—चञ्चरीकावली (˚क-आवली), f. a kind of metre
consisting of four lines of thirteen syllables each.

चञ्चुरी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, constantly practising or en-
gaged in.

चञ्चूर्गमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, following evil practices,
behaving ill, addicted to wickedness, wanton.

चञ्चल चञ्चल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens. of rt.
चल्), moving to and fro, movable, unsteady, shaking,
trembling; unsteady, inconstant, inconsiderate, quiver-
ing, flickering, playing, moving irregularly; fickle;
(अस्), m. the wind; a lover, a libertine, a lecher;
(आ), f. lightning; long pepper; fortune, Lakṣmī or
the goddess of fortune; N. of a metre consisting of
four lines of sixteen syllables each.
—चञ्चल-ता, f.
or चञ्चल-त्व, अम्, n. movableness, unsteadiness,
inconstancy, fickleness.
—चञ्चल-हृदय, अस्, आ,
अम्, capricious, fickle, false-hearted.
—चञ्चला-
क्षिका (˚ल-अक्षि), f., N. of a metre consisting of
four lines of twelve syllables each.
—चञ्चलाख्य
(˚ल-आख्˚), अस्, m. incense.

चञ्चुल चञ्चुल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्),
m. pl. the descendants of this man.

चाञ्चल्य चाञ्चल्य, अम्, n. (fr. चञ्चल),
tremulousness, unsteadiness; transitoriness, fugitive-
ness, fidgetiness.
